source.authority: Internal Shariah desk review, cross-referenced against Thetanuts V4 supported assets (docs.thetanuts.finance/sdk/getting-started/supported-chains)
source.note: Fail-closed: an asset absent from this file, or not marked COMPLIANT, is treated as REJECT by underlying_screen.py. Extend this list only with a written rationale citing docs/shariah-policy/*.md. `category` drives routing in underlying_screen.py -- see docs/RWA_AND_CATEGORIES.md for the full taxonomy and worked examples.

records.rationale: Non-interest-bearing digital commodity; no embedded yield, coupon, or debt claim. Widely reviewed by contemporary Shariah boards as an asset (mal) rather than a Riba-bearing instrument.

Native network asset with utility (gas/computation), not a debt instrument. Screen applies to spot ETH only -- see cbETH/wstETH-style rebasing or fixed-yield staking derivatives, which are NOT covered by this record and default-reject.
Native network asset, non-interest-bearing. Same caveat as ETH: liquid-staking derivative tokens are separate records, not implicitly covered.

1:1 custodial wrapper over BTC with no embedded yield or rehypothecation-for-interest disclosed. Treated as a proxy for spot BTC for screening purposes. Re-review if issuer terms change to include yield.
1:1 non-custodial wrapper over ETH via smart contract, no yield accrual. Proxy for spot ETH for screening purposes.

Fiat-backed stablecoin used only as a cash-collateral / settlement unit in this system, never held as a yield-bearing position and never supplied to a lending/interest venue by this agent. Conditional on: (1) never routed through Thetanuts loan/CALL_LOAN tools, (2) never deposited to a yield vault by this codebase. collateral_gate.py enforces both.

records.asset_name: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund
records.rationale: Tokenized claim on a fund holding US Treasury bills, cash, and repo. The yield paid to holders IS interest (Riba al-Nasiyah) by construction, regardless of the blockchain wrapper. underlying_screen.py hard-rejects every rwa_debt record in code, not just here, so this entry cannot be flipped to PASS by editing this file alone -- see check_token().

records.asset_name: Ondo Short-Term US Government Bond Fund
records.rationale: Same structure as BUIDL: tokenized short-term US Treasuries. Direct Riba exposure -- treasuries pay a coupon/discount that is definitionally interest.
Yield-bearing dollar note backed by short-term Treasuries and bank deposits; the 'yield' in the name is the tell -- it is interest income passed through to holders.

Each token is fully backed by one fine troy ounce of allocated physical gold held in a Brink's vault, redeemable for physical delivery. No yield or coupon -- not a Riba concern. The open question is Riba al-Fadl / qabd (possession): gold and silver are classically 'ribawi' items where classical fiqh requires hand-to-hand spot exchange. Whether an on-chain, redeemable, audited allocated-gold claim satisfies constructive possession is a live debate among contemporary scholars (some boards, e.g. covering the older Gold-i/OneGram products, ruled allocated + redeemable structures acceptable; others require physical delivery). Treat as scholar-review-required, not auto-PASS, before writing an option against it.

Illustrative record, not a specific live token -- included to show how the category would be screened. A fractional real-estate token backed by real rental income is closer to an Ijarah (lease) structure than a debt instrument: return comes from rent (usufruct), not interest. Conditional on: (1) the property itself has no interest-bearing mortgage financing behind it, (2) the underlying business/SPV passes the same debt-ratio and non-halal-income screen as an equity (reuse sec_edgar_screen.py's ratio approach, or the issuer's own compliance disclosure), (3) the rental use of the property is itself permissible (no bar, gambling hall, etc., per Related.md).

records.asset_name: Tokenized public equity, e.g. Backed Finance-style xStock wrapper (illustrative)
records.rationale: Illustrative record. A tokenized-equity wrapper is only as compliant as the underlying company -- it must clear the SAME screen the equity Ai_Finance_Syariah project already runs (business activity + interest-bearing-debt and non-halal-income ratios via sec_edgar_screen.py), per-issuer, not as a blanket category. Defaults to REJECT here because no specific issuer has been screened; add a per-symbol record (e.g. 'AAPL-XSTOCK') only after running the actual equity screen on that issuer, same as the fail-closed pattern everywhere else in this file.
